title: Star Trek Timelines — Redcon (Player-POV What If?)
tts_note: MiniMax Speech 2.8-HD. Voice: Deep_Voice_Man (authoritative, measured). Second-person monologue throughout — NOT first-person alternate-self. Voiceover opens with the CTA hook on the teaser clip, then continues second-person through story clips.

format_overrides.note: Player-POV variant. Character = the player (Starfleet Timeline Commander). Each episode: one canonical crisis, one cross-era crew assembled in-game, one divergence outcome.
format_overrides.structure: TEASER (clip 1, TTS starts) → TITLE CARD (clip 2, silent) → HOOK+CTA (clip 3) → CANON REMINDER (clip 4) → CREW ASSEMBLED (clip 5) → DIVERGENCE (clip 6) → REVELATION (clip 7) → CTA asset

voiceover_hook.template_en: Imagine, you downloaded Star Trek Timelines from the link in bio… and [outcome in one clause].
voiceover_hook.note: Must appear in clip 1. The phrase 'from the link in bio' is mandatory for CTA attribution.

cta_clip.spoken_cta_en: Download Star Trek Timelines free — link in bio.
cta_clip.spoken_cta_note: Short spoken CTA embedded in clip 3 (hook). Does NOT replace the cta.mp4 asset at the end — both are used.

player_character.name: Starfleet Timeline Commander
player_character.description: Generic adult human player-captain. Black-and-red Starfleet command uniform, gold combadge, four rank pips. No celebrity likeness.
player_character.note: Same character ref every episode. Visual consistency is required — always chain from this sheet.

done.note: Pre-bible run. Pilot episode. Locutus signal isolation.

done.crisis: Breen energy-dampening weapon — Battle of Chin'toka (2375)
done.note: Frequency modulation cracked before Allied fleet annihilated. Dominion War ended 6 months early.

style_tags: Star Trek Timelines style, semi-realistic Pixar-quality 3D, cinematic Federation lighting, deep space environment, Starfleet uniform details, clean cinematic frame, no cartoon, no chibi
color_palette: deep space black #0a0a12, LCARS orange #ff9900, Federation blue #3366cc, LCARS purple #9966cc, rarity gold #ffd700, warp blue #00ccff

character_variant_episodes.note: One-off classic-character redcon episodes (canonical character + alternate-self, first-person monologue) — NOT part of the Player-POV crisis_rotation numbering above. Kept separate so future runs don't confuse these with the numbered player-POV series or its do_not_repeat list.

done.alternate_designation: Worf, Son of None — Warlord of the Empire
done.divergence_point: 2367, TNG 'Reunion' — after executing Duras, Worf refuses discommendation and seizes the Duras bloodline's ships/warriors instead of returning to Starfleet
done.tts_voice: Daniel (ElevenLabs preset, mapped to MiniMax Deep_Voice_Man for generation) — flat/angry alternate-identity delivery, not the canonical Worf voice
done.notes: User-requested one-off ('what if Worf became a villain'), not the player-POV crisis-rotation format. Included a user-requested CTA banner image overlay (fade in/out, top-anchored) on clip 3 only — required extending tools/overlays.py: (1) build_image_overlay_frags() needed fade_in/fade_out support for image overlays (previously text-only), which surfaced an eof_action=repeat default that stalls the whole filtergraph when combined with an infinite loop=-1 still-image source — fixed with eof_action=pass; (2) banner placement/scope went through 3 rounds of user feedback (all clips -> clips 2-3 top -> clip 3 only) — final: top-anchored, y=80, width~1010 (35px side margins), fade ~0.5s, clip 3 only. Also flagged in rules/formats/redcon.md: this format's monologue-over-static-shot pacing reads as static even with technically-compliant motion_prompt — push camera movement harder and prefer wider framing over tight portraits.

done.alternate_designation: The Absolute Judge — Executioner of the Continuum
done.divergence_point: 2364, TNG 'Encounter at Farpoint' — Q puts humanity on trial aboard the Enterprise-D and, refusing to accept Picard's proof that humanity can change, condemns the Federation instead of granting mercy
done.outcome: Captured: Picard, frozen conscious as an eternal witness to his species' failure. Died: the Starfleet officer who raised a phaser at Q, unmade on the spot as a warning. Q then turns on his own Continuum and destroys the members who try to stop him, becoming uncontested — and, with no equal left to judge him, his own eternal prisoner.
done.tts_voice: Deep_Voice_Man (MiniMax Speech 2.8-HD), cold/commanding judge delivery — not the canonical playful-trickster Q tone
done.new_asset: Alternate-self 'Absolute Judge' Q ref generated (darker palette, gold-white eyes, black-and-crimson robe, unstable energy corona) at assets/star-trek-timelines/characters/q/variants/absolute-judge.png — chained from the existing canonical-self q/avatar.png for the 'before' shots
done.notes: User-requested one-off ('what if Q became evil'), same character-variant branch as the Worf episode. Total pipeline cost ~$3.67 (Sound $0.09, Storyboarder $0.64, Animator $2.94, Editor $0.00). Applied the Worf postmortem note proactively this run — Storyboarder used wide framing and Animator used harder camera pushes/orbits from the start, no retro-fix needed.
